sources.label: Godox TL60 product page and TL60/TL120/TL180 manual
sources.scope: Official page carries images and the manual download; its text has no spec table. Copies of the manual (EN/CN and JA) are in the NNC pack but could not be machine-read.

sources.label: Retailer copies of the Godox TL60 specification
sources.locator: Digital Camera Warehouse, Scan and Photospecialist listings, read 17 October 2026
sources.scope: 48 × 750 mm, 730 g, 18 W max, RGB 2700–6500 K, CRI 96 / TLCI 98, 14.4 V 2600 mAh battery, 20 V 2.4 A adapter, about 2 h at full power, DMX 32 channels in 6 groups over RJ45, app and remote control.

sources.label: NNC gear record
sources.scope: Unit identity, quantity, and retailer-reproduced figures where the manufacturer page no longer carries them.

sources.label: NNC equipment inventory

components.label: RGB tube
components.purpose: 750 mm tube, 48 mm across, 730 g: 18 W RGB with 2700–6500 K white, CRI 96 and TLCI 98.
components.limits: Length, diameter and weight are retailer copies; the Godox page has no spec text.

components.label: Control panel and display
components.purpose: Buttons and a small display at one end for mode, colour temperature, hue, saturation, brightness and effects; the app and the RC-R9 style remote do the same wirelessly.

components.label: DC charging input
components.purpose: Input for the 20 V 2.4 A adapter that charges the 14.4 V 2600 mAh battery; about two hours at full power on battery.

components.label: DMX over RJ45
components.purpose: RJ45 DMX connection, 32 channels in 6 groups; an RJ45 cable ships in the kit, so an XLR-to-RJ45 adapter is needed for a standard DMX line.

components.label: End caps with 1/4-inch threads
components.purpose: Threaded end caps for stands, clamps or the included brackets.
components.limits: Thread size not confirmed from a manufacturer page.

evidence_policy.physical_verification: None; no dimension or placement has been checked against a physical unit

page.practice_cards:
Simulated TL60 state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Tube on the DMX line
The TL60 takes DMX on RJ45, not XLR. Keep the adapter with the tube or run it from the app and leave it off the console.
Channel chart lives in the manual.
